sig: [[["B", "Oliver, I need a quick update. Are we set for the Kenton order? They want twelve hundred units shipped by the 22nd."], ["A", "Not quite, Dana. I ran the count this morning, and we've only got about nine hundred in stock."], ["B", "Nine hundred? The system showed fifteen hundred last week."], ["A", "I know. It turns out a batch of three hundred was damaged in the flood at the Dover site, and nobody updated the records."], ["B", "That's not ideal. Can the factory make up the difference in time?"], ["A", "I called them. They can do it, but not until the 25th."], ["B", "That's three days late. Kenton won't be happy."], ["A", "What if we send the nine hundred on time and the rest as a second shipment? We'd cover the extra shipping cost."], ["B", "That might fly. I'll run it by their buyer and get back to you by end of day."]], {"A": "M-GB", "B": "F-US"}]
